plain_english_revision: The amendment removes certain online gambling formats from the definition of 'video lottery' and explicitly excludes bingo and horse-race betting (pari-mutuel) from that category.
candidate_position_supported: Narrows the state’s video lottery program to exclude mobile/internet-based games and pari-mutuel betting, while preserving bingo as a separate activity.
evidence_quotes: any mobile or Internet-based or monitor-based interactive game
All forms of bingo and pari-mutuel wagering are excluded from the definition of video lottery
review_reason: No hidden dependencies on other bill sections; amendment is self-contained.
